reviewer.subject: Final standalone FormSeed3D GLB renders for WP27Ar5, WP23Ar5, WP29Ar5 and WP82Ar6 at the preserved source checkpoints, as described by the requester. I did not see any checkpoint, GLB or render-evidence hash myself.

evidence.1000: In right, the zigzag notch (about x 50–525, y 357–490) is the dark interior wall seen through the torn rim. A small lit inner-corner facet (about x 100–135) is the only local depth cue. Consistent with the prior attribution, I treat the notch as physical geometry, not a painted mark. In front-three-quarter, the floor patch near the tear (about x 240–350, y 350–410) is distinguishably lighter than the walls. In top, the floor is a dark-gray slab with a faint lighter perimeter and a corner highlight (about x 455–490, y 80–180). In rear-three-quarter, the tan exterior steps sharply to a near-black interior at the torn rim, and the mounting blocks (about x 150–215, y 325–380 and x 420–478, y 490–540) are near-black with soft cast shadows. Left shows a clean exterior with the two blocks.
evidence.256: In right, the notch still reads as a dark cutout with no visible wall thickness. Top is a uniform dark slab. Front-three-quarter and rear-three-quarter keep the open-box reading.
evidence.128: In right, the notch reads as a dark zigzag band. In front-three-quarter and rear-three-quarter, it still reads as an open, torn box.

nonBlockingObservations: The floor-to-wall separation is visible at 1000 only. At 256 and 128 the interior reads as one dark mass. The prior optional W03R4BoxWall albedo trial (≤0.09 linear) stays optional. I do not prescribe it.

objections.severity: minor; geometry check, not a finish change
objections.evidence: In 1000-front there is a continuous thin vertical line on the end face (about x 724, y 50–928), and nearly edge-on dark slivers along the right edge (about x 745–772, y 180–590). A faint trace of the line is visible near x 188 in 256-front. It is not legible at 128.
objections.note: This may be torn-rim faces seen edge-on, which would be benign, or a seam or sliver face. I did not open prior isolation 1000-front, so I cannot say whether it is unchanged.
objections.action: Run a read-only mesh visibility or face-attribution check on the 1000-front pixels around x 724 before finishing. Make no change unless an open seam or degenerate face is confirmed.
